The Wildlife Conservation Society submitted a Notice to Mariners regarding planned acoustic monitoring work near the Hudson Canyon. The project involves deploying four small, fully submerged acoustic recorders at four sites near the northern end of Hudson Canyon to detect vocalizing cetacean species and characterize the ambient underwater noise environment. The equipment consists of compact acoustic recording units suspended approximately two meters above the seafloor between an anchor and a small sub-surface float. The design has no surface expression and uses an acoustic release system intended to leave no equipment or mooring on the seafloor after recovery.
